timing_verdict.label: BAD
timing_verdict.text:
VERDICT: BAD timing to buy USD with KRW now

RATE: ~1540 KRW/USD (with recent highs near 1400s referenced as historical benchmark)

WHY: The news indicates the won is currently WEAK (high KRW per USD), making dollars expensive to buy. While one article mentions "1400원 다시 볼 수 있을까" (could we see 1400 won again), the consensus is for "고환율 지속" (sustained high exchange rates) around 1540 won, suggesting the won will likely remain weak or weaken further near-term.

TIP: Consider splitting your monthly $2,000 purchase into smaller weekly or bi-weekly amounts to average out the unfavorable rate, rather than buying all at once when the won is weak.
